summary: Discretionary quota allotment challenge; Punjab Town Improvement Rules (1983); 5% government discretionary quota declared arbitrary under Article 14; invalidation of allotments to MPs/MLAs/NRIs under discretionary quota; Shashi Bala's plot allotment claim precluded by post-2003 Full Bench ruling; prior judicial approval of allotment unaware of declared illegal quota framework; High Court directions set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Punjab Town Improvement (Utilization of Land and Allotment of Plots) Rules, 1983 s.4
CWP No. 7401 of 1996 Dr. Amar Singh and others Vs. State of Punjab
Anil Sabharwal Vs. State of Haryana
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court's directions quashed; Trust not obligated to allot plot under invalidated discretionary quota regime.
